name: vitrine-ui
description: Generative UI for conversations that sell. The model picks from a typed component registry; the client renders. Spoken design system, interruptible springs, no dependencies.
author: Rafael De Marco <rafael@flow-labs.io>
//: No `main`, on purpose. The library is five browser scripts with a load
order — registry, theme, renderer, planner, runtime — that attach to
globals. Declaring a single entry point would imply a bundle that does
not exist. Load them with script tags, in that order; see the README.
src/registry.js is the exception: it has no DOM dependency and runs in
Node unchanged, which is how you validate blocks server-side.

scripts.test:registry: node -e "global.window=global;require('./src/registry.js');const{validateBlock}=global.VitrineRegistry;const ok=validateBlock({component:'text',props:{body:'hi'}});const bad=validateBlock({component:'finance_slider',props:{unitId:'x',unitName:'y',price:100}});if(!ok.valid)throw new Error('valid block rejected');if(bad.valid)throw new Error('finance card accepted without apr/termMonths');console.log('registry ok — Reg Z fields are enforced by the schema')"
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:registry && npm run measure && npm run audit
